name: Corrosive Effluents
text: Use in your Shooting phase or either player's Fight phase, before you pick the next unit to shoot or fight, for one of your DEATH GUARD units that has not yet been selected to shoot or fight this phase. Until the end of the phase, every attack made by a model in that unit has its Armour Penetration improved by 1.

name: Harbingers of Despair
text: Use at the start of either player's Fight phase, for one of your DEATH GUARD units that is within Engagement Range of at least one enemy unit. Every enemy unit within Engagement Range of it takes a Battle-shock test right away.

name: Disgustingly Resilient
text: Use in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has picked its targets, when one of your DEATH GUARD units was picked as a target. Until the end of the phase, every attack allocated to a model in that unit has its Damage reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.
